findings.evidence: `expression.IsImmutableFunc` returns true for any non-`*ScalarFunction` (default branch) (`pkg/expression/util.go:1353-1370`). `buildPartialPaths4MVIndex` passes `sf.GetArgs()[1]` / `sf.GetArgs()[1-jsonPathIdx]` into `jsonArrayExpr2Exprs` for `json_contains/json_overlaps` without restricting it to constants (`pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go:1308-1327`). `jsonArrayExpr2Exprs` then calls `jsonArrayExpr.EvalJSON(..., chunk.Row{})` after the permissive `IsImmutableFunc` check (`pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go:1647-1652`). If that argument is a `*expression.Column` (e.g. `json_contains(mvcol, other_json_col)`), `Column.EvalJSON` calls `row.IsNull` (`pkg/expression/column.go:499-503`), and `chunk.Row.IsNull` dereferences `r.c` (`pkg/util/chunk/row.go:221-222`), which panics for `chunk.Row{}`.
findings.fix: Make the “safe to Eval* with `chunk.Row{}`” predicate reject row-dependent expressions. Minimal fix: change `IsImmutableFunc` to return `true` only for `*Constant` and for foldable `*ScalarFunction` whose args are also `IsImmutableFunc`, and return `false` for other expression kinds (at least `*Column`, `*CorrelatedColumn`, subquery expressions, etc.). Alternatively, keep `IsInmutableExpr`-style default `false` and add a `*Constant` case that returns `true` even when `ParamMarker/DeferredExpr` exist (plan-cache skipping is already handled separately).
findings.impact: Blocker correctness/runtime risk: optimizer can panic while generating MVIndex plans for queries that match MV index predicates but use a non-constant RHS for `json_contains/json_overlaps` (e.g. column, correlated column, or function over a column). This can crash the query (and possibly the server if panic isn’t fully contained) instead of cleanly deciding “cannot use MVIndex”.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (ref `b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943`): `pkg/expression/util.go` still has `IsImmutableFunc` defaulting to `true` for non-`*ScalarFunction`, and `pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go` still evaluates `jsonArrayExpr.EvalJSON(..., chunk.Row{})` guarded only by `IsImmutableFunc` (no additional column/subquery guard). No fix found in `git log 54cca35..upstream/master -- pkg/expression/util.go pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go`.
findings.verify: Add a planner regression test (or manual SQL repro) with an MVIndex table and a predicate like `json_contains(mv_json_col, other_json_col)` / `json_overlaps(mv_json_col, other_json_col)`; ensure optimization does not panic and simply declines MVIndex path construction. Also cover `cast(other_col as json)` and correlated-column variants.
findings.what: Planner can panic when extracting JSON array elements for MVIndex planning because `IsImmutableFunc` is too permissive (treats `*Column` etc as “immutable”), leading to `EvalJSON(..., chunk.Row{})` on row-dependent expressions.

subject: planner: choose to generate optimal plans without plan cache rather than generating suboptimal plans and caching it when generating MVIndex plans (#51546)
summary: Found a Blocker: the new `IsImmutableFunc` check is overly permissive, so MVIndex planning may evaluate non-constant JSON expressions with `chunk.Row{}` and panic (not fixed on `upstream/master` as of the checked ref).
